integrity: The complete new residual-contact classification is separate from pre-existing order-sequence descriptions; all computational checks are reproducible in the included standalone program.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is specific to the characteristic-three prime-field model, and is not a classification of arbitrary twists or boundary osculating-plane residuals. Exact Hasse arithmetic and incidence calculations were verified; historical novelty assessment is limited to accessible published texts and records. No independent scientific audit has been performed.
title: The residual-contact graph of canonical hyperosculating planes on the characteristic-three Artin–Mumford curve
